title: SignalIngest
description: Canonical shape that every n8n provider workflow normalizes into before calling POST /signals on the signal-processing backend. Provider-specific payloads (Chartink, TradingView, ...) never reach the backend directly.

strategy_id.description: Which signal-generation Strategy this signal belongs to - carries the ?strategy_id= query param from the provider webhook URL through. signal-processing resolves horizon/instrument_type by looking this up (GET /strategies/{id} on signal-generation) rather than guessing.

symbol.description: Exchange trading symbol, e.g. RELIANCE, NIFTY.

exchange.description: Which exchange/segment this symbol trades on - determines which quote provider execution uses for CMP at square-off. NSE and MCX are wired up (via Dhan); widen this enum (CRYPTO, ...) as new segments/providers are added.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601. If the provider doesn't send one, the n8n workflow stamps received time.

source_meta.description: Provider-specific passthrough metadata for traceability (e.g. Chartink scan_name). Not used by resolution logic.
